versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-checked (verify_all.py fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json version). pageSpecVersion is machine-checked against the schema's pageSpecVersion const (the PageSpec shape did not change in 1.1.0, so it stays 1.0.0). repositoryVersion is documentation-only and hand-maintained; nothing checks it.

source.site: refire.com/int/ (live marketing site of Refire, a real hydrogen fuel-cell company)
source.authorization: the user is authorized by Refire to rebuild it
source.project: the parent directory of this design-repo (a pixel-faithful clone); not shipped

countsNote: Recomputed from disk by extraction/verify_all.py on every run; a mismatch fails.
entryPointsNote: Only files inside this design-repo. External evidence (source files, specs, captures) is cited in extraction/measured-values.json.

outOfScope.en.refire.com: deliberate scope reduction chosen by the user; a separate site with its own design system; must NOT be recreated from this repo

structuralFactsNote: Each id is detailed with citations in extraction/measured-values.json structuralFacts.

sourceStack.note: Recorded for traceability. It never shapes token names, section ids, schema fields or validator logic.

clone.styling: Tailwind CSS v3 (tailwind.config.cjs) + global CSS; fluid sizing via a --vw-unit custom property and f{N}/fmin{N} utilities, resolved in this repo to {designPx[,minPx]} token values

sourceStack.original: Next.js static export with GSAP 3.8 and a custom virtual-scroll engine (per CLONE_SPEC.md section 0.1)

delivery.sourceProject: run the clone with `npm ci` then `npm run dev` / `npm run build` from its lockfile; never ship node_modules
delivery.designRepo: Python 3.8+ and `pip install -r extraction/requirements.txt` (jsonschema>=4). The design-repo adds nothing to the project's package.json.
delivery.zip: python3 extraction/package.py builds ../design-repo.zip with the CLI zip tool, excluding __MACOSX, .DS_Store, Thumbs.db and desktop.ini; regenerate it last after every change and never commit it next to the live folder
